title: Trader habit profile with private interpretations that the trader can read and correct
problem_register_class: RC4 — Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T5)
design_choices: Facts and interpretations have different owners. Facts (services/agora/habit_profile.py, stored in agora.habit_profiles) are derived by fixed rules from the trader's own decision locks, journal entries and servant widget context; no language model computes a feature. Interpretations are the servant's reading of those facts and exist only in the servant persona's private memory.

Interpretation statements are rule-based text with no digits; the numbers stay in the cited habit facts, so a statement cannot disagree with the profile it reads and the 11/16 'no model computes a number' rule holds.

Event-driven recompute without a schedule: a decision lock write flags the trader's profile rows stale; the next read (GET /bff/agora/servant/habits or a servant turn) recomputes and writes a new version only when the input digest changed. The derivation is a pure function of its inputs (computed_at is not an input).

The memory owner has no supersede route, so a replacement entry lists what it supersedes in content.structured_payload.supersedes and readers hide those entries; the in-process adapter also calls PersonaMemoryStore.supersede. Nothing is deleted.

A trader correction (reject, replace, add) is admitted as training_example evidence through AgoraEvidenceWriteService (the existing dataset pipeline, T4/SD §7) and then supersedes the interpretation in memory. A feature the trader corrected is not re-derived over the trader's own words.

The servant turn carries the profile as habit facts h1..hN (separate from the 30 tool-fact budget). The model cites them with {{hN}}; the BFF renders values. A propose_research proposal carries habit_refs naming every habit fact carried and those facts are cited with it.

procedure_after_deploy: GET /bff/agora/servant/habits as the dev trader: record the profile (each feature with sample_size) and interpretations_status
POST a servant message and read /stream: record metadata habit_profile.cited_fact_ids
PATCH /bff/agora/servant/habits {action: replace, interpretation_id, statement} with an Idempotency-Key: record the training_example evidence_id
POST a second servant message and record that the answer now reflects the corrected statement and not the superseded one

runtime_budget.new_persistent_stores_or_tables: agora.habit_profiles (one row per trader and strategy)
runtime_budget.new_recurring_jobs_or_timers: none (event-driven: lock write marks stale, next read recomputes)
runtime_budget.size: about 4 KB per profile (hard cap 8 KB, source refs trimmed first); row holds the latest plus 12 superseded versions
runtime_budget.growth_and_cap: at most 13 profiles per trader and strategy; a profile write happens only when the input digest changed; private memory holds at most 24 live interpretation entries per servant persona (MAX_ACTIVE_INTERPRETATIONS)
runtime_budget.cleanup: older profile versions deleted on write; derived interpretation entries expire after 180 days and trader corrections after 365 days (expires_at, archived by the memory owner); superseded entries are kept until expiry
